verses.text: God, the nations have come into your inheritance. They have defiled your holy temple. They have laid Jerusalem in heaps.
lines: God, the nations have come into your inheritance.
They have defiled your holy temple.
They have laid Jerusalem in heaps.

verses.text: They have given the dead bodies of your servants to be food for the birds of the sky, the flesh of your saints to the animals of the earth.
lines: They have given the dead bodies of your servants to be food for the birds of the sky,
the flesh of your saints to the animals of the earth.

verses.text: They have shed their blood like water around Jerusalem. There was no one to bury them.
lines: They have shed their blood like water around Jerusalem.
There was no one to bury them.

verses.text: We have become a reproach to our neighbors, a scoffing and derision to those who are around us.
lines: We have become a reproach to our neighbors,
a scoffing and derision to those who are around us.

verses.text: How long, Yahweh? Will you be angry forever? Will your jealousy burn like fire?
lines: How long, Yahweh?
Will you be angry forever?
Will your jealousy burn like fire?

verses.text: Pour out your wrath on the nations that don’t know you, on the kingdoms that don’t call on your name;
lines: Pour out your wrath on the nations that don’t know you,
on the kingdoms that don’t call on your name;

verses.text: for they have devoured Jacob, and destroyed his homeland.
lines: for they have devoured Jacob,
and destroyed his homeland.

verses.text: Don’t hold the iniquities of our forefathers against us. Let your tender mercies speedily meet us, for we are in desperate need.
lines: Don’t hold the iniquities of our forefathers against us.
Let your tender mercies speedily meet us,
for we are in desperate need.

verses.text: Help us, God of our salvation, for the glory of your name. Deliver us, and forgive our sins, for your name’s sake.
lines: Help us, God of our salvation, for the glory of your name.
Deliver us, and forgive our sins, for your name’s sake.

verses.text: Why should the nations say, “Where is their God?” Let it be known among the nations, before our eyes, that vengeance for your servants’ blood is being poured out.
lines: Why should the nations say, “Where is their God?”
Let it be known among the nations, before our eyes,
that vengeance for your servants’ blood is being poured out.

verses.text: Let the sighing of the prisoner come before you. According to the greatness of your power, preserve those who are sentenced to death.
lines: Let the sighing of the prisoner come before you.
According to the greatness of your power, preserve those who are sentenced to death.

verses.text: Pay back to our neighbors seven times into their bosom their reproach with which they have reproached you, Lord.
lines: Pay back to our neighbors seven times into their bosom
their reproach with which they have reproached you, Lord.

verses.text: So we, your people and sheep of your pasture, will give you thanks forever. We will praise you forever, to all generations.
lines: So we, your people and sheep of your pasture,
will give you thanks forever.
We will praise you forever, to all generations.
